name: ahw_picks_v1
what: P(the wallet AHwJSnFNUiAU9FfT5ewW2osqMo938WtL7KhfsJyfpaN2 attempts this launch): its picking, as a pre-send gate. Cuts (entry.presend_cut, the gate skips score < cut): t1 = keep about 1 in 3 of bundled in-class launches (the looser gate); t2 = keep about the wallet's own attempt share of bundled in-class launches (1 in 4.6, the strict gate). Operator block trained at OpStats::default() (the live store holds paper outcomes only); funding masked; hour / weekend / regime held constant; create rates held at their defaults

dropped.metadata JSON (m_*, meta_ok): fetched ~450 ms after the create (p50), after the slot-0 decision
dropped.cu_used: an execution result (meta.computeUnitsConsumed), not in the shred
dropped.name / symbol text (name_len .. name_dig: Unicode-table definitions (isalpha, CJK names) not reproducible bit for bit outside Python; AUC 0.53-0.59 alone (G1 ablation)
dropped.op_g1_prior_log: counts creates in the 1.27 % gap-1 sample; a live bot has no such sample
dropped.op_busy: needs 15 minutes of trades after each launch; the live store is written 10 s after each launch

tertiles.protocol: not tertiles: weighted quantiles of 5-fold (contiguous time blocks) out-of-fold scores over the bundled (nB >= 1) in-class rows; t1 keeps 0.333 of them, t2 keeps the wallet's attempt share of them (0.216)

threshold.t1_meaning: keep ~1 in 3 of bundled in-class launches (presend_cut = "t1")
threshold.t2_meaning: keep ~1 in 4.6 of bundled in-class launches = the wallet's attempt share (presend_cut = "t2")

training.label: AHwJ attempted (landed buy or failed buy tx)
training.population: in-class: SOL quote, not mayhem, Token-2022, not cashback, dev buy > 0
training.weights: pos 1; negatives weighted to their stratum's pool
